other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
The applicant must be a woman worker employed in building and other construction works.
The worker must be registered with the Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
The membership must be active at the time of application.
The woman worker is not entitled to benefits in case of a second marriage.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹1,000 during the period of maternity.
